grammar.title: On one hand... on the other hand... with 一方面...另一方面...
grammar.pattern: 一方面 + A，另一方面 + B
grammar.explanation: 一方面...另一方面... (yī fāngmiàn...lìng yī fāngmiàn...) presents two sides of a situation — "on one hand..., on the other hand...". It's common in formal explanations that weigh different factors.

sentences.zh: 一方面他想休息，另一方面他还有很多工作。
sentences.pinyin: Yī fāngmiàn tā xiǎng xiūxi, lìng yī fāngmiàn tā hái yǒu hěn duō gōngzuò.
sentences.en: On one hand he wants to rest, on the other hand he still has a lot of work.

sentences.zh: 一方面我喜欢这个城市，另一方面这里的房子太贵了。
sentences.pinyin: Yī fāngmiàn wǒ xǐhuan zhège chéngshì, lìng yī fāngmiàn zhèlǐ de fángzi tài guì le.
sentences.en: On one hand I like this city, on the other hand the houses here are too expensive.

sentences.zh: 一方面他很努力，另一方面他也很幸运。
sentences.pinyin: Yī fāngmiàn tā hěn nǔlì, lìng yī fāngmiàn tā yě hěn xìngyùn.
sentences.en: On one hand he works hard, on the other hand he's also lucky.
